messages:
jules: Heads-up: noticing a weird negative line on INV-21680 for CueLabs. Looks like a combination of SDK retries + an experiments flag that applied free-tier credits twice. Need finance + ops to triage before we contact the customer. @mike @ana

mike: Whoa. Negative line? Can you paste invoice window and the billing_journal id?

jules: Window=2027-03-11T23:30:00Z..2027-03-12T01:00:00Z. billing_journal=BJ-9982. Bot alerted earlier.

billing-bot: ALERT: billing_negative_balance | invoice=INV-21680 | customer=cuelabs-42 | delta=-73.45 | reason=credit_overapply | severity=high

ana: (typo) ana: Quick summary: SDK v1.9 had a retry loop after transient auth error around 23:40Z which replayed ~4k short embedding requests. Ingest dedupe worked, but the experiments service returned a "free-tier-override" for each retry due to an edge race, and our crediting job applied credit per event id without dedupe.

mike: Can you show the query you used to find duplicated credits?

jules: ```sql
SELECT e.request_id, e.payload_hash, c.credit_id, c.applied_at, c.reason
FROM embeds.events e
LEFT JOIN billing.credits c ON c.request_id = e.request_id
WHERE e.customer_id='cuelabs-42' AND e.timestamp BETWEEN '2027-03-11T23:30:00Z' AND '2027-03-12T01:00:00Z'
ORDER BY e.timestamp LIMIT 200;
```

jules: Spooled sample to /tmp/cuelabs-double-credits.json. Lots of identical request_ids with two credit rows each: reason="free-tier-override" and reason="experiment-freecredit".

product-experiments-bot: NOTICE: experiment_toggle | name=free-tier-override | rollout=edge-nodes | changed_by=product:staging->prod | time=2027-03-11T23:38:12Z

ana: Ops note: we rolled experiment on edges at 23:37Z as part of a staged rollout. The toggler had a bug that didn't mark idempotency for retries so downstream crediter treated each attempt as separate. This is the first time the experiment overlapped with a heavy retry window.

mike: Finance: rough exposure = 4120 duplicate events * average embed price $0.018 = $74.16 in overcredits. Bot reporting -$73.45 due to rounding and previous discounts. Propose provisional reversal of the over-applied credit and a post-mortem fix.

cs-lead: CS wants to proactively reach out to CueLabs but legal suggests we wait until we revert credits if customer balance is negative. They prefer messaging: "We discovered an internal crediting error; we're correcting your invoice and will follow up with a reconciled statement."

jules: Remediation plan: (1) run targeted credit-reversal job to revoke credits with reason="experiment-freecredit" for affected request_ids, (2) patch experiments toggler to be retry-idempotent, (3) run reconciliation and update invoice if needed. Ops ETA for job ~30-90m.

mike: I'll approve a provisional ledger reversal to remove the -73.45 negative line so customer isn't shown as owing us money. Finance: please prepare journal entry: debit=73.45 reason="reversal provisional - experiment double-credit". Hold final until recon report.

ana: Started job rev-reverse-441 at 2027-03-12T00:05:21Z. Will post completion and reconciled delta. Also opening experiment bug EXPR-2207.

product-experiments-bot: ACTION: create_bug | id=EXPR-2207 | title="free-tier-override idempotency on retries" | assigned=ana | severity=high

mike: Finance note: provisional reversal approved. Please CC CS.

cs-lead: Notifying CueLabs with provisional language. Will wait for final reconciled doc before closing the loop.

jules: Job rev-reverse-441 completed at 2027-03-12T00:32:09Z. Reconciled delta: +73.12 applied to invoice (rounding difference). Attaching CSV to billing_journal BJ-9982.

mike: Final action: mark EXPR-2207 priority and schedule hotfix. Finance: reconcile ledger with new CSV and close provisional entry. Thanks everyone.
